next_step: Run 2-week perf POC (streaming + tool-calls), capture first-token latency metrics, finalize pricing for Dedicated option
notes:
Snapshot: mid-market SaaS vendor building chat-first customer support product. Primary product is an in-app agent + escalation flow. They need streaming (progressive replies) and robust tool-calling to query internal KBs and CRM.

- Business context: VP Product (Lena Ortiz) wants fast time-to-value — prefer Hosted API initially to avoid infra lift, but will evaluate Dedicated for capacity isolation and better unit economics after POC.
- SLOs: <1.5s first-token for typical 2-3 turn sessions; p95 end-to-end for short answers <500ms overhead target. Streaming required (UX dependency).
- Workload: 40k monthly chats initially, peak concurrency up to ~180 concurrent users during business hours; expected growth x3 in 12 months.
- Tech constraints: must integrate with SAML SSO, audit logs to customer tenant, retention policy 90d configurable, optional EU data residency for EU customers.
- Model preferences: open-models ok but want Redwood-verified latency profile; want cheap fallback for long-context or batch reranking.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market buying profile — price-conscious but willing to commit for predictable latency and fewer support incidents.
- Quote: "We need streaming latency to feel realtime — the UI stalls today and agents escalate too often." — Lena Ortiz, VP Product.
- POC ask: 2-week perf POC using Hosted API with sample production traffic (anonymized). Must provide token-level cost estimates and guidance on batching/kv-caching.
- Security: filled initial security questionnaire (drive link), waiting on SOC2 details and KMS integration notes.
- Decision criteria: live demo with <1.5s first-token, reproducible perf report, pricing scenario for 6/12 month committed Dedicated pool.

Notes style: shorthand, bullets, action items. Use-case is focused; team eager to move quickly if Hosted meets latency SLOs.
